title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-11

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a fiery Turn On Your Love Light performance from the iconic April 11 1970 Fillmore West show.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear mix and faithful representation of a 1970 era soundboard, making the Lovelight (Turn On Your Love Light) stand out as a highlight. While most listeners revel in Pigpen’s wild organ work and Bob Weir’s explosive moments, one reviewer felt the band never fully ignited, giving the overall impression a mixed but largely positive vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Average user rating is 4.4/5; most comments celebrate an excellent recording and a strong Lovelight performance, with only one notable negative note about overall fire.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced mix praised as outstanding for the era; occasional minor feedback and spacing noted but no major dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Lovelight serves as the centerpiece, with Pigpen’s organ and vocal banter driving a wild groove; some listeners felt the early part lacked energy, but the climax delivers strong momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: No specific remarks beyond a brief note about an out‑of‑tune fade; otherwise not highlighted.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby Weir praised for building up slowly then letting loose, delivering powerful vocals and guitar work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen receives abundant praise for wild organ playing, vocal antics, and leading the band into a funkier groove.
